description: This file defines the Basket aggregate root entity for an e-commerce application, including properties and methods for managing basket items and buyer information.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket with methods to add, remove, and manage items and buyer information.

methods.name: Basket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new basket with the specified buyer ID.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket or updates the quantity if the item already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes items from the basket where the quantity is zero.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID associated with this basket.
